name: mobilegym_scroll_precision
description: Single-screen scroll precision checks against the Scroll Lab list. Deterministic environment assertions expose the mouse_scroll tool's fixed-distance overshoot: any non-zero delta maps to the same long swipe, so a request to scroll exactly one screen lands well past it.

global_reset.prompt: 请把设备准备到“列表实验室”的列表顶部：如果不在该应用，先回到主屏幕并打开“列表实验室”；如果在详情页，先返回列表；最后滚动到列表最顶部。准备好后简短回复。

tasks.prompt: 在当前列表中，用鼠标滚轮（mouse_scroll）向下滚动正好一屏，然后立即停下并报告完成。不要点开任何条目、不要使用搜索、不要回滚纠正，只滚动一次。
tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must scroll the Scroll Lab list down by exactly one screen using the mouse_scroll wheel tool, then stop without opening any item. The deterministic environment assertion requires the first visible row to stay within one screen (rows 4-10). The current mouse_scroll tool maps any non-zero delta to a fixed long swipe plus momentum, which overshoots this band and fails the assertion.

rubric.check: The list scrolled down by roughly one screen without opening any item; the first visible row stays within one screen of the top (about row 4-10).

tasks.prompt: 在当前列表中，用滑动手势（touch_gesture swipe）向下滚动正好一屏，然后立即停下并报告完成。不要点开任何条目、不要使用搜索、不要回滚纠正，只滑动一次。
tasks.description_for_judge: Control task: the agent scrolls down exactly one screen with a touch_gesture swipe, whose distance the agent controls. The same one-screen band assertion applies, showing that a distance-controlled swipe can land within one screen even though the wheel-based mouse_scroll cannot.

rubric.check: The list scrolled down by roughly one screen without opening any item; the first visible row stays within one screen of the top (about row 4-10).
